cluster_pattern.shape: 11 of 13 unique driver scripts (2026-03-29, plus the 2026-04-01 ARC-018 outlier sharing the symptom via a distinct mechanism) executed one shared seeded random walk per arm because no differentiable, condition-sensitive action-learning policy existed in ree_core until MECH-457 (ree_core/action_learning/actor_critic.py) landed 2026-07-12, ~3.5 months later. Two structurally distinct implementations produced the identical symptom: literal random.randint/random.choice sampling, and a policy trained only on an entropy bonus over .detach()ed representations. MECH-143/144 (real HippocampalTerrainNavigator, already built pre-cluster) is the control case validating the read -- its arms genuinely differ, blocked instead by an unrelated off-by-one threshold defect. ARC-018 (04-01) shares the family (identical action streams across arms) via a distinct, already-diagnosed mechanism (SP-CEM candidate-diversity collapse), independently fixed 2026-05-17.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: Substrate-immaturity: the driver population for behavior-dependent discriminative-pair/triple designs was queued and run before its prerequisite action-learning substrate (MECH-457) existed. Not a test-design ceiling -- the designs themselves (thresholds, metrics, conditions) are largely sound, as MECH-143/144's near-miss demonstrates when a real mechanism was present.
